Hi, my name is Paul. I’m a TESOL-Certified English Communication Coach and educational Content Creator. I grew up in Miami Beach and currently live in Buenos Aires. I have a degree in audiovisual media and communication, and earlier in my career, I worked as a television writer and producer. In my free time, I enjoy running, music and journeying into fascinating worlds via stories.

But stories are much more than something I enjoy in my free time. I believe stories are the most powerful form of communication. So powerful they can transform any message, vision or experience into something meaningful and memorable. TED Talks are a perfect example of this. Imagine if most business communication had this power, this energy.
That is why I created an approach to English Mastery called Storylingo. It’s a story-based approach to English communication that has allowed me to help hundreds of professionals and job candidates from all over the world achieve their business communication goals in English.

The result is speakers of English as a foreign language that can communicate their ideas in a way that is clear and engaging. Storylingo is available as a workshop, as personalized coaching and soon, as an online course. I’ve used this system of training at leading organizations including Santander Group, Siemens, and Alibaba.

teacher_info.about_teacher:
I believe that after understanding the basics of the language, students learn best by learning a language in context. In other words, after attaining a basic understanding of reading, writing, listening and speaking, it is best for students to continue their learning journey based on topics that interest them.

As a result, I like to make classes personal and tailor-made to the student's interests and needs. I encourage the student to speak as much as they can. I listen and take notes. And then, I model another version of the same idea with corrections in pronunciation, pacing and/or more frequently used language elements. Students are then encouraged to emulate to the best of their ability.

pro_course_detail.title: Improve Your Vocabulary, Accent and Pronunciation with Texts
pro_course_detail.description:
This format is best for those who want to expand their vocabulary and improve their accent.  Many people do not know that accent is more than just your pronunciation; it also includes your intonation patterns, the rhythm of your speech, and the fluency of your speech.  You can have perfect pronunciation but still not sound like a native if you lacking in the other areas of your speech.  

These classes are made to specifically work on accent reduction and building your vocabulary.  To do this, we will use text a digital text which you will read it aloud.  We will focus on specific vowel and consonant sounds , syllable and word stress, and rhythm patters to help you sound more like a native.  

Since we will be using native level content, you will also be exposed to new vocabulary, phrases and sayings.  We will discuss the text and I will help you with any doubts you have.  The texts will be on topics of interest to you so that you can use the vocabulary in your daily life.  The possibilities are endless and include:
- News articles
- Blog posts
- Short stories
- Passages from novels

You can also bring any material that you like, for example a book you are reading, a text for work, a novel for school, etc.  As long as you have the text in a digital format, we can use it in our sessions.
